item.text:
No additional defect was confirmed in this pass. Two runtime boundary cases were checked and passed:

- `tick_period = 0` did not starve the command channel in the Tokio test runtime.
- `egress_period = 0` also remained command-responsive.

The audit remains at 28 confirmed findings. The highest-impact issues remain LFU protocol-level replica divergence, delta-snapshot corruption, decided-index regression during sync, persistent failed-write leakage, timeout retry duplication, and zero-capacity runtime startup panic.

All reproduction commands and retained outputs are documented in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
